issue.title: Add a reference memory note documenting remote dispatch operations
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-xe.15 (note #7) and confirmed by the sase-xe land agent: epic sase-xe deliberately left sase/memory/ untouched (per its own phase instructions), so no reference memory covers the shipped remote-dispatch surface. Anyone landing routine dispatch work must re-derive it from source. The note should cover: the sase machine enrollment/repair flow (bootstrap bundle, installation-identity pinning, quarantine + 'sase machine repair'), the dispatch: config shape (providers/machines/discovery, credential_ref indirection into the 0600 fleet credential store), the follow-store and Focus/Fleet running-count semantics (viewer-local follows, family promotion, unfollow tombstones, partial counts), the %dispatch launch/operation-key recovery model, and operational recovery for a quarantined or unreachable host. Memory writes require /sase_memory_write; this bead is the sanctioned route.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Create a new reference memory note (type: reference) named dispatch.md covering remote dispatch operations: machine enrollment/repair, dispatch: config and credential store shape, follow-store and Focus/Fleet count semantics, %dispatch operation-key recovery, and quarantined/unreachable-host recovery.

payload.description: Epic sase-xe shipped the remote dispatch feature this memory note must document; its plan and phase notes are the primary sources.
